name: Scarring in Glaucoma Filtration Surgical Procedures

ethnicAssociations: Higher incidence in Afro-Caribbean and Asian populations

criteria.description: Presence of fibrotic, flat, or encapsulated filtering bleb on slit-lamp examination
Elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) refractory to medical therapy post filtration surgery
Failure of aqueous humor filtration demonstrated by reduced bleb function or absence of bleb drainage
Anterior segment optical coherence tomography (AS-OCT) or ultrasound biomicroscopy showing bleb fibrosis
Prior history of trabeculectomy or other glaucoma filtration procedure

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of fibrotic bleb with elevated IOP refractory to medical therapy following glaucoma filtration surgery
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical supported by imaging and surgical history.

pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic fibrotic bleb visible on slit-lamp exam

pathognomonic.symptomName: Elevated intraocular pressure refractory to medical treatment
searchTerms: high eye pressure not responding to meds
glaucoma with resistant elevated eye pressure

common.symptomName: Decreased visual acuity due to uncontrolled glaucoma
searchTerms: decreased eyesight due to high eye pressure

common.symptomName: Ocular discomfort or foreign body sensation
searchTerms: eye irritation or feeling something in eye
ocular discomfort or foreign body sensation

occasional.symptomName: Corneal edema secondary to elevated IOP
searchTerms: swollen cornea from high eye pressure
corneal edema secondary to elevated IOP
redness and swelling in eye front
engorged blood vessels on eye surface

rare.symptomName: Bleb leak or hypotony due to bleb failure
searchTerms: leaking bleb causing low eye pressure
bleb failure leading to eye pressure drop

rare.symptomName: Choroidal detachment secondary to elevated IOP
searchTerms: detached choroid from high eye pressure
eye layer separation from elevated IOP

imaging: Anterior segment optical coherence tomography (AS-OCT) showing bleb fibrosis and reduced filtration
other: Slit-lamp biomicroscopy revealing fibrotic bleb morphology

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of hypotony and bleb leakage

redFlags: Rapidly increasing intraocular pressure despite medical therapy
Signs of bleb infection or blebitis
Sudden vision loss or severe ocular pain
references: Wells AP, et al. Management of scarring after glaucoma filtration surgery. Eye (Lond). 2017.
Gedde SJ, et al. Postoperative complications of glaucoma surgery. Ophthalmology. 2019.
